info.name: spotify hello kitty emo
info.description: this is if u want a cute emo/scene vibe for ur spotifyy !!
info.additionalInfo: I hope this works for y'all! if it don't leave a comment and lmk

style.css: /* Custom Pink Emo Background */ [class*="Root__top-container"], [class*="main-view-container"] { background-image: url("https://www.google.com/imgres?q=emo%20hello%20kitty%20bg&imgurl=https%3A%2F%2Fi.pinimg.com%2F736x%2Fd6%2F13%2F2d%2Fd6132daac7e6ebeeef165be88364d3da.jpg&imgrefurl=https%3A%2F%2Fin.pinterest.com%2Fpin%2F995858536354755239%2F&docid=JaEWOa-w9idrDM&tbnid=shQoH7KGpmuP5M&vet=12ahUKEwiPsrewgIWWAxVU4ckDHXtbA1kQnPAOegQIPRAA..i&w=736&h=1308&hcb=2&ved=2ahUKEwiPsrewgIWWAxVU4ckDHXtbA1kQnPAOegQIPRAA") !important; background-size: cover !important; background-position: center !important; background-repeat: no-repeat !important; background-attachment: fixed !important; } /* Make Spotify panels transparent so your image shows through */ [class*="main-view-container__scroll-node-child"], [class*="Root__main-view"], [class*="Root__nav-bar"], main, section { background-color: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.4) !important; background-image: none !important; } /* Turns the main play buttons and accents neon emo pink */ [class*="ButtonInner-sc"], [class*="encore-bright-accent-set"] { background-color: #ff007f !important; color: #ffffff !important; }
